resources.string: Turn on sharing, choose a region and connect to a node. A startup server helps phones find their first contacts without exchanging codes.
This is the discovered part of the network. Countries and free slots are signed claims from participants; an announcement does not prove connectivity.

Optional HTTPS address. The server exchanges temporary signed announcements and encrypted pairing messages. VPN traffic goes through participants. Known connected phones continue sharing the catalog if the server stops; new entry may require it again.
